events.outcome: Current provider instructions resolve the legacy validity gap: three months from first activation, twelve months after every recharge, then a one-month expired window in which incoming calls/messages and recharging remain possible.

data.acquisitionSummary: Elisa Prepaid is sold through Elisa and Finnish retail channels and has no bills or monthly fee. Elisa states that the prepaid subscription cannot be registered under the subscriber's name or personal identity number. The subscription must be activated in Finland before it can be used abroad; eSIM activation is also Finland-only.

keep.action: Recharge at least EUR 10 before expiry. Every recharge extends the subscription for 12 months; after expiry there is a one-month receive/recharge recovery window before closure.

data.chinaActivation: Elisa states that the subscription must be activated in Finland before use abroad. China-first activation is therefore not supported by current provider instructions.
data.kyc: Elisa states that Prepaid cannot be registered under the subscriber's name or personal identity number; do not generalize this into a broader legal claim beyond this product.
data.payment: Balance can be topped up EUR 10-100 through the Prepaid shop/app and supported Finnish retail channels; card payment is supported in the app.
data.roamingSms: Elisa states that Prepaid works abroad for calls/messages/data, but China-specific incoming SMS and OTP reliability are unverified.
data.refund: Balance or packages are non-refundable on the eSIM shop.
data.tariffSummary: 3 months from first activation; every recharge extends 12 months; minimum balance top-up EUR 10; one-month expired receive/recharge window.
guideSteps: Acquire and activate Elisa Prepaid in Finland.
Before each 12-month validity window expires, recharge at least EUR 10.
Treat the extra one-month expired receive/recharge period as recovery, not the normal maintenance target.
